opening.text: A lighthouse does not move. It stands on the shore and shines so ships can find safe water. The captain does not need to like the rocks. He just needs to see where they are.
Prophets are like that for us. Let’s talk about why God gives them.

mainMessage.text: God has always called prophets. He prepares them, and He speaks through them. We have a living prophet today. When we follow him, we stay safe and steady.

blocks.text: God gives us lighthouses.
The Lord does not leave His children in the dark. Amos said He reveals His plans to the prophets. Paul said no one takes this honor on himself.
Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
Elder Allen D. Haynie of the Seventy said this in his talk “A Living Prophet for the Latter Days” from the April 2023 general conference.
Father in Heaven has chosen the pattern of revealing truth to His children through a prophet.
This is how God has always taught His children.
Built with care.
A lighthouse is built to last. God prepares a prophet over time. Moses was sent to lead Israel. Samuel grew up in the temple, and the Lord was with him.
Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
And Samuel grew, and the Lord was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.
Elder Allen D. Haynie of the Seventy said this in his talk “A Living Prophet for the Latter Days” from the April 2023 general conference.
A prophet is someone God has personally prepared, called, corrected, inspired, rebuked, sanctified, and sustained.
God stays close to those He calls.
A light for today.
God still calls a prophet to lead His Church. The Lord said the President of the Church is a seer, a revelator, a translator and a prophet. He told us to heed his words.

And again, the duty of the President of the office of the High Priesthood is to preside over the whole church, and to be like unto Moses— Behold, here is wisdom; yea, to be a seer, a revelator, a translator, and a prophet, having all the gifts of God which he bestows upon the head of the church.

Wherefore, meaning the church, thou shalt give heed unto all his words and commandments which he shall give unto you as he receiveth them, walking in all holiness before me; For his word ye shall receive, as if from mine own mouth, in all patience and faith.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Prophets, Seers, and Revelators” from the October 2004 general conference.
I testify of His prophets, seers, and revelators, who constitute the ongoing foundation of that Church.
The Lord has not stopped calling prophets.
Believe and be established.
King Jehoshaphat told his people to believe the Lord’s prophets and prosper. The Lord told the Church there is only one appointed to receive commandments and revelations for it.

And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the Lord your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
And this ye shall know assuredly—that there is none other appointed unto you to receive commandments and revelations until he be taken, if he abide in me.
Elder Allen D. Haynie of the Seventy said this in his talk “A Living Prophet for the Latter Days” from the April 2023 general conference.
Knowing by revelation that there is a living prophet on the earth changes everything.
Trust grows when we know it for ourselves.
Safe from the winds.
A lighthouse helps in storms. Paul said God gave apostles and prophets so we would not be tossed about by every wind of doctrine. Moses taught that God would raise up a prophet.

And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers; For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
The Lord thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Prophets, Seers, and Revelators” from the October 2004 general conference.
The First Presidency and Quorum of the Twelve are commissioned by God.
God gives us guides so we do not drift.
Built on a strong foundation.
The Church is built on apostles and prophets, with Jesus Christ as the chief cornerstone. God also promised to raise up His word again in later days.
And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;

And in a day when the children of men shall esteem my words as naught and take many of them from the book which thou shalt write, behold, I will raise up another like unto thee; and they shall be had again among the children of men— among as many as shall believe.
Elder Allen D. Haynie of the Seventy said this in his talk “A Living Prophet for the Latter Days” from the April 2023 general conference.
That is why we should not seek to use the words of past prophets to dismiss the teachings of living prophets.
The light still shines, and it is not the same light every night. It is for tonight’s storm.

story.title: Noah and the ark

blocks.text: Noah was warned of a flood that had not yet come. The sky was clear.

And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth. Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
Noah listened and built. He was safe because he trusted the prophet’s warning before the rain came.

And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers; For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
The Lord thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Prophets, Seers, and Revelators” from the October 2004 general conference.
The First Presidency and Quorum of the Twelve are commissioned by God.
In the storm, the needle still points true.
Pointing to Christ.
The Church is built on apostles and prophets. Jesus Christ is the cornerstone. God promised He would give His words again in later days.
And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;

And in a day when the children of men shall esteem my words as naught and take many of them from the book which thou shalt write, behold, I will raise up another like unto thee; and they shall be had again among the children of men— among as many as shall believe.
Elder Allen D. Haynie of the Seventy said this in his talk “A Living Prophet for the Latter Days” from the April 2023 general conference.
That is why we should not seek to use the words of past prophets to dismiss the teachings of living prophets.
Every true prophet points to the Savior.

story.prompt: The member tells a true time they followed the counsel of a prophet. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: The times of restitution

blocks.text: Peter spoke to a crowd about Jesus Christ and what would come in the last days.
Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
God has spoken through prophets since the beginning. He still does.

application.text: First, ask yourself where you most need direction. Second, find the prophet’s counsel on that topic. Third, follow one piece of it this week.

testimony.prompt: The member adds their own words. Lines the app offers:

blocks.text: I know God speaks through His prophets. I know He has called one to lead His Church today. I know that all of them point to Jesus Christ. I say these things in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.

invitations: I invite you to ask yourself where you most need direction.
I invite you to find the prophet's counsel on that topic.
I invite you to follow one piece of it this week.
blessings: You will find guidance for your own need.
You will feel the Spirit confirm it.
You will walk with more confidence.

closingVerse.text: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
